text: That's what I'm able to do. You literally do nothing. Do you realize that right now, if I worked one day a week, which I'm doing now, I would make more than you make in an entire week. You literally do nothing. You're so lazy. Your existence is worthless right now. It's absolutely worthless. I want to make a suggestion. Your kids are dirty. Like, I don't understand. Did you give Livia back today? Because you seem to be wearing the same thing as last night. Surprise, surprise. Not surprise at all, actually. Did either of them eat anything that wasn't junk? I need you to engage with me in a way, because we can't have you just keep repeating yourself. I really get it. But do you want some help in changing things? Yeah, but I don't think that things are going to change by him just constantly saying, I disagree, I disagree. She doesn't see me. She doesn't see what I do. You know what? You want me to not see what you do? Stop doing everything, because you literally do nothing. Look, guys, I don't even want to waste time explaining what kind of partner this woman is. It is pretty self-explanatory. She's sitting in therapy, screaming that her husband does nothing, calling him lazy, worthless, useless, while he just sits there quietly, probably wondering at which point in his life he lost every ounce of dignity. Because, man, where is your self-respect? This woman is insulting you to your face in front of a therapist while you sit there, absorbing punches like a noob boxer. She tells you your existence is worthless, and you stay. She mocks your income, and you stay. She belittles your effort as a father, and you stay. You are not a hostage. You are not trapped. You are a grown man choosing to stay with someone who clearly hates you. Instead of walking away, you are trying to fix it in therapy. No amount of therapy is going to save a relationship where one partner despises the other. You cannot negotiate respect with someone who already decided you don't deserve any. And let me say something about this therapist. I'm not saying all therapists are bad, but the more I get familiar with what they advise, the more I think some of them actually make things worse. Instead of calling her behavior out, instead of telling the men to grow a pair, instead of telling them that their marriage is shit and they should divorce, she's trying to sugarcoat everything as communication issues? To hell with a therapist like that. If you are serious about changing your life, start by leaving situations that destroy you. Work on yourself. Build a spine again. Get your confidence back. Your kids don't need a father who is broken. They need a father who shows strength and self-respect. And for all men watching, don't ever let it get this far. Set standards early. Set boundaries early. And if a woman talks to you like this, you don't need therapy. You need her out of your life.
